name: WHO Ambient Air Quality Database v8.0 (2026)

measures.definition: Fine particles under 2.5 micrometres, measured at the city's monitoring stations: the annual mean the city reported.

licence: WHO terms for data compilations (public-health use, unaltered values; not CC BY)

rights.edition: WHO Ambient Air Quality Database, Version 8.0, released 30 June 2026 (sheet GlobalCity_Db_V8.0_2026-06-28)
rights.attribution: World Health Organization, WHO Ambient Air Quality Database (Version 8.0), 2026, accessed 2026-10-27; data provided by the national and regional agencies named in each value's note
notices: WHO does not endorse Borgo, its use of these data, or any city ranking built from them.
Values are as published by WHO; WHO advises against using the database to rank cities or compare countries directly, because monitoring differs between places.

vetted.notes: The measured reference. No CORS and an xlsx, so the CLI and MCP fetch it; the browser uses CAMS.

caveats: Values are stored exactly as published, with the data provider WHO names for the row (WHO terms).
Station mix differs by city (traffic or background).
Published in its own file (public/data/dataset-who.json) under WHO's terms, never inside the CC BY 4.0 compilation.
